summary: V1 UX Freeze e2e: manual orders + ask_ananta toggle + strategy state toggle. Backend 11/11 pytest passed (POST /api/orders/manual paper BUY market notional, LIMIT-below-market rests, paper SELL fraction, sell-no-position 404, bad-side 400, missing-amount 400, symbol-not-enabled 400, public 403; ask_ananta_enabled PUT+GET persistence; strategy state disable/enable). WEB (/): after clicking bottom-nav-trade, ORDERS subtab is active by default; manual-order-card + active-strategies-card render; strategy-toggle-supertrend flipped true->false; ask-ananta-toggle flipped false->true and persisted (toast 'Ask Ananta disabled' on revert). MOBILE (Expo): owner sign-in + onboarding skip works; Trade tab shows ORDERS default with manual-order-card/submit/notional/side-buy, strategy-toggle-hunter, sticky-ai-coach + sticky-add-strategy; Workspace shows ask-ananta-toggle. No parity divergence.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1500+ lines (Trade + Settings + Watchlist + Backtest + Coach + Research all in one). Consider splitting into routers per domain to keep files under ~700 lines.

SELL LIMIT above bid raises 400 (limit_price > snap.bid) but the check uses order.limit_price directly without a None-guard when otype=='LIMIT' and limit_price is None — earlier LIMIT block already validates limit_price>0, so this is safe; still worth an explicit assert for clarity.
seed_data_creation: None. Manual paper BUY (BTC $20, ETH $30, ARB $20) and paper SELL 50% ETH were placed against the paper ledger as expected by the review request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth token localStorage key on WEB is 'ananta_owner_token' (not ananta_auth_token). AppShell renders tabs client-side; there is no /trade or /workspace route — click [data-testid='bottom-nav-trade' / -workspace'] instead. First-visit onboarding is gated by localStorage['ananta_onboarded']; set it to '1' to skip. Global conftest.py auto-injects owner Bearer into mutating requests — to test public 403 you must bypass requests.Session (use urllib). Mobile app has an owner login screen + a per-session onboarding animation ending in 'ENTER ANANTA' (SKIP works too).
